mapper.sql: a.achievement_id, a.management_no, a.teacher_user_id, u.login_id AS teacher_name, a.organization_code, a.evaluation_year, a.management_item_code, a.achievement_date, a.achievement_status, a.attachment_ref, d.special_lecture_start_date, d.special_lecture_end_date, d.mock_exam_question_period, a.created_at, a.updated_at
FROM education_achievements a JOIN employment_rate_improvement_achievement_details d ON d.achievement_id = a.achievement_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = a.teacher_user_id
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.organization_code FROM organization_user_mappings m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND #{date} >= m.effective_start_date AND (m.effective_end_date IS NULL OR #{date} <= m.effective_end_date) ORDER BY m.organization_code
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evaluation_element_management_item_settings s WHERE s.management_item_code = #{code} AND s.area_code = 'EDUCATION' AND s.active_yn = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE education_achievements SET management_item_code = #{body.managementItemCode}, achievement_date = #{body.achievementDate}, attachment_ref = #{attachmentRef}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{userId} WHERE achievement_id = #{id} AND achievement_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_IMPROVEMENT' AND deleted_yn = 'N'
